summary: Approvals: persistent approval bar plus a bottom sheet. ui/ApprovalSheet.kt (new, replaces ui/ApprovalCard.kt and its confirmation dialog): ApprovalPanel renders, pinned in the conversation's bottom bar directly above the composer (outside the reverse LazyColumn, so it stays visible wherever the conversation is scrolled), a one-line bar for the head of the selected project's approval queue: tool, side effect and 'N pending', one-tap Deny / Allow icons (same 'Allow|Deny approval <id>[ for worker <w>]' descriptions as before) and a 'Review approvals' target that opens a ModalBottomSheet. The sheet shows 'Awaiting approval' with i/N (i counts approvals answered from this sheet that have left the queue, N = i-1 + queue size), tool, effect, request id, worker, preview path, the patch coloured per line (+ green, - red, @@ primary; theme-aware light/dark), redaction/truncation/withheld flags and the digest, with one-tap 'Deny' / 'Allow once'. While this device holds approval control and the queue is non-empty, the sheet cannot be dismissed (confirmValueChange refuses Hidden, back press disabled, scrim/swipe ignored); it closes by itself when the queue drains; without approval control it is a read-only, dismissable view. Optional biometric confirmation: a 'Confirm with biometrics' switch in the sheet (shown when the platform BiometricManager reports BIOMETRIC_STRONG or DEVICE_CREDENTIAL available; off by default, persisted in the app-private 'zenpi-ui' SharedPreferences) routes each decision through the platform android.hardware.biometrics.BiometricPrompt (no new library; USE_BIOMETRIC permission added). pairing/ApprovalDecisionPolicy.kt: queue(state) (selected project's pending approvals, empty unless CONNECTED/ERROR) and decides(state, shown) = shown is the queue head AND allows(); the UI enables buttons with decides, re-checks it against the latest state when a (biometric) confirmation lands, and PairingViewModel.approve now also requires decides, so approvals are processed strictly in queue order and a changed digest/summary disables or refuses the decision.

notes: Deviations / decisions: (1) Owned paths ui/ApprovalSheet.kt (new) and pairing/ApprovalDecisionPolicy.kt. Also touched: ui/ConversationScreen.kt (hosts ApprovalPanel above the composer), ui/ConversationSection.kt and ui/AppShell.kt (old approval cards and confirmation dialog removed), ui/UiState.kt (approvalDecision state removed), ui/ApprovalCard.kt deleted, pairing/PairingViewModel.kt (approve requires decides: one line), AndroidManifest.xml (USE_BIOMETRIC), screenshot Fixtures (queued approvals), Portrait.kt (captureScreenGolden for popups; clipping check over all windows), migrated androidTests ApprovalScreenTest (one-tap sheet instead of confirm dialog), SessionScopeScreenTest (opens the sheet) and HostPairingTest (opens the sheet; harness-only test, not runnable here). (2) The one-tap design replaces the old Allow -> 'Allow this tool once?' confirmation dialog: the sheet itself is the review surface; the bar's icons decide without opening it, as in the §3.2 sketch. (3) Decisions only for the queue head: i/N progresses as the host removes answered approvals; there is no browsing ahead (YAGNI, and it keeps 'queue order' enforceable). (4) Biometric uses the platform BiometricPrompt (minSdk 31) rather than androidx.biometric, so no dependency was added; BIOMETRIC_STRONG or DEVICE_CREDENTIAL. (5) Robolectric does not deliver injected touches into the sheet's window, so the JVM tests click sheet buttons through the semantics OnClick action; the touch path, back press and swipe are covered on the emulator. (6) No protocol change: approve uses the existing workspace approve command.
